item.title: ABC News: Rural communities feel locked out of national childcare fund
item.description: It was a fund designed to reduce the number of childcare deserts in Australia, but industry advocates say the Building Early Education Fund has left rural communities behind.

item.title: ABC News: Basin communities feeling drained as more water buybacks considered
item.description: The federal government has not ruled out using more water buybacks to make up a shortfall in a key Murray-Darling Basin Plan water-saving target.

item.title: ABC News: Car destroyed in another suburban firebombing in Melbourne's north-west
item.description: A car has been destroyed in an arson attack in Keilor less than 24 hours after a firebombing in nearby Taylors Hill.

item.title: ABC News: Trauma support urged for witnesses of Knights fans car crash
item.description: Experts warn that people who saw a car hit 10 Knights fans in Newcastle could face an emotional toll, and want support to be offered.

item.title: ABC News: Concerns as new $1.2b recycling facility will service data centres
item.description: Western Sydney's Kemps Creek facility announced the treatment centre would now factor water needed to service NSW data centres.

item.title: ABC News: 'Huge gap' between employers and abuse survivors over workplace support
item.description: Research by the Humans for Purpose Academy finds the vast majority of survivors felt inadequately supported by their workplaces as they escaped domestic and family violence.

item.title: ABC News: SA government advertising spend hits record levels
item.description: The Malinauskas government has spent nearly $200 million on advertising in its first four years in office, including a record spend last financial year.

item.title: ABC News: Police investigate whether hunters shot horse in Geelong
item.description: The 27-year-old horse was found with a gunshot wound in a paddock in Lovely Banks last month.

item.title: ABC News: Do you have what it takes to be a delivery driver in China?
item.description: Workers in the world's largest gig economy are being paid as little as $45 a day and sometimes going months without a day off. The ABC hears from one of them.

item.title: ABC News: Why NRL grand final 'freak' is making Wallabies lick their lips
item.description: It was not just the 80,000 spectators, nor the millions of TV viewers in Australia, who were left in awe of Mark Nawaqanitawase's performance in the NRL grand final.

item.title: ABC News: Overdose death involving possible synthetic opioid sparks health warning
item.description: Health authorities in Tasmania have issued a public warning after an overdose death that may have been brought about by drugs "possibly laced with a strong opioid".

item.title: ABC News: Jobseekers exploited by scammers on LinkedIn
item.description: Sophisticated fraudsters posing as recruiters and using other dubious tactics are taking advantage of desperate jobseekers after announcing they're #opentowork.
